== Original post ==

'''Ralitiir Stooper Trooper'''
* '''Author:''' chris "Austin316" morris
* '''Published:''' February 14, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 3.5
* '''Description:''' well its pritty basic to work out trap em with 1 then pound em with many

=== Strategy ===

ok

Well all deck u start with stragic reserves the idea is get a site every turn when u have all 8 out put a storm trooper at 3 and wait till they come after him the ghhhhk him and then deploy vader tarkin and a lot of free storm troopers trooper assult and dark jedi presence but delpoy a couple at other sites with the objective flipped u have + 8 to your desity draw not that u need it with appros 10 stormtrrops at power 6 and dark and  tarkin it will be all over in a matter of 1 battle A special thank goes to Master for the insperaion for this deck.
